<thought>Carbon shows a clear M+1 series (~1 Da spacing) and chlorine shows a distinct M+2 peak (~2 Da spacing) with ~25 % intensity relative to the monoisotopic peak, matching the natural Cl‑35/Cl‑37 isotopic ratio. No other element’s characteristic isotopic pattern is evident. Therefore the definitively identifiable elements are carbon and chlorine.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
